cv_writer.description: Writes and redrafts the tailored CV; the filter model drops critique suggestions that clash with the user's earlier requests

cover_letter_writer.description: Writes and redrafts the cover letter; the filter model works as for cv_writer

critique.description: Scores each draft, checks it against the ad's requirements, writes redraft instructions and compares equally honest drafts

grounding.description: Lists claims in a draft that the candidate's own material (or, for the employer, the ad and company research) does not support

router.description: Talks to the user and decides the next step

job_description.description: Extracts structured fields from the job ad

search.description: Summarises Tavily search results into a company description

document_reader.description: Reads the CV and cover letter files (PDF or text)

rag.description: Only for a portfolio over 12,000 characters: checks whether retrieved portfolio items are relevant to the job (smaller portfolios go to the writers whole)
rag.rationale: Threshold 1.5 (L2 distance) keeps loosely similar items; the model check then filters them. Embeddings use OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (or an Ollama embedding model for ollama: models).

template_customizer.description: Turns the final CV / cover letter text into LaTeX, applying the user's style requests

latex_fixer.description: Repairs LaTeX documents based on pdflatex error output so they compile
